    Recover rows from the original input snapshots

    original_rows.Rd

    The returned rows preserve the original column classes and values, and add the appropriate .row_x or .row_y traceability column.

    original_rows(
  cmp,
  side = c("x", "y"),
  type = c("affected", "changed", "only", "all")
)

    Arguments

    cmp

    A daffiz_comparison from compare_dt().

    side

    Either "x" or "y".

    type

    Which rows to recover: all affected rows, matched changed rows, side-only rows, or all original rows.

    Value

    A data.table copied from the stored input snapshot.

    Details

    Column order follows x on both sides: preflight aligns y to the validated column order of x (design plan section 4.1, gate 4), so the two sides stay directly comparable. For side = "x" that is also the input's own order.

    Examples

    x <- data.frame(id = 1:2, amount = c(10, 20))
y <- data.frame(id = 2:3, amount = c(20, 30))
cmp <- compare_dt(x, y)
original_rows(cmp, "x")
#>       id amount .row_x
#>    <int>  <num>  <int>
#> 1:     1     10      1
original_rows(cmp, "y", type = "only")
#>       id amount .row_y
#>    <int>  <num>  <int>
#> 1:     3     30      2
